segments.caption: In a brick-walled courtyard, three men are engaged in a synchronized, multi-level workout. Two men perform push-ups on the ground, while a third man sits atop a low brick wall, executing crunches with his hands behind his head. The scene is dynamic, with one man climbing the wall and another standing on top of it, highlighting a coordinated, high-energy fitness routine.

This segment showcases the dynamic, urban discipline of parkour, centered around the Charlotte Parkour group. It opens with a low-angle shot of a man performing a sit-up on a brick ledge, while others are seen climbing and moving across a brick wall in the background, establishing the physicality and environment. The focus then shifts to Steven Erdmanczyk, a member of Charlotte Parkour, identified by his branded green shirt and on-screen text. The segment culminates with

A man performs a dynamic parkour sequence on a university campus, beginning with a handstand atop a large, circular stone monument, then transitioning to a running leap over a low brick wall and railing, showcasing agility and control against a backdrop of trees and campus buildings.

A young man in a green shirt and dark shorts performs an acrobatic stunt, leaping over a low brick wall in an outdoor campus setting, landing gracefully on the other side before turning to face the camera.
A man in a green shirt is shown scaling a low brick wall in an urban setting, with the sequence capturing his upward climb and a close-up of his focused expression.
A man in a green shirt scales a brick wall, then transitions to doing push-ups on a stone ledge before walking away with a companion through an outdoor patio area.

A group of young adults, including a man with red hair in a green shirt, are gathered outdoors on a grassy field near a parking lot, seemingly preparing for or participating in a physical activity or game, with one man crouching in a ready stance while others stand and watch.

A group of young men are gathered outdoors in a grassy area, performing a synchronized, energetic exercise routine that involves extending their arms forward in unison, suggesting a workout or team-building activity. The scene transitions from a casual walk near parked cars to the focused group activity, with the camera capturing the motion and coordination of the participants.

A group of young men are engaged in an intense outdoor game of tug-of-war on a grassy field, with one player in a green shirt prominently featured as he strains and pulls with his teammates against their opponents.
A man in a green t-shirt stands outdoors in front of dense foliage, speaking and gesturing with his hands as he addresses the camera.

A man in a green shirt leads a group of young people through an outdoor physical training session in a grassy, wooded area. He demonstrates movements, and the group follows by performing squatting and bending exercises. The scene shifts to a different location near parked cars, where the same man continues to instruct, gesturing as he speaks to two other participants.

Three young men stand outdoors in a gravel lot beside a car, engaged in a conversation. The taller boy on the right gestures animatedly as he speaks, while the boy in the center, wearing glasses, listens with his arms crossed. The third boy, in a red shirt, enters the frame from the left and joins the group, observing the interaction. The scene is set against a backdrop of a red garage door and a chain-link fence, suggesting a casual, informal gathering.

Three young men stand in a gravel lot beside parked cars, appearing to be in a tense or confrontational conversation, with one crossing his arms and another gesturing. The scene then cuts to a different location, an outdoor campus plaza with brick buildings, where a shirtless man is seen preparing to perform a trick on a metal railing while another man watches from a nearby ledge, suggesting a transition to a skateboarding or parkour activity.

A group of young men are gathered on the steps and walkways of a university campus, engaging in a series of playful, acrobatic stunts. One man prepares to jump from a brick ledge, while others, some shirtless, gather to watch or participate in the antics, culminating in a group huddle of camaraderie. The scene is set against the backdrop of red-brick academic buildings and trees, capturing a moment of youthful energy and friendship.

A group of young men gather on stone pedestals in a courtyard, initially standing apart and gesturing. They then move to embrace each other in a tight, celebratory group hug atop one pedestal, while the building’s arched architecture and brickwork form the backdrop.

A group of young men gathers atop a brick ledge in front of a university clock tower, beginning with a tight, celebratory group hug before dispersing to strike various confident, posed stances for the camera, concluding with a title card for the Charlotte Video Project.
